name: Cable Pallof Press
steps: Stand side-on to a chest-height pulley and hold its handle against your sternum with both hands.
Extend your arms straight ahead while keeping your chest facing forward.
Draw your hands back to your sternum.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your hips and shoulders square against the sideways pull.
Pause briefly with your arms fully extended and exhale to brace your core.
